## Result — two least-used documentation formats (data-supported)

**BDD_Scenarios: 2.062% (95% CI [0.515, 4.124])** and **MLCanvas: 7.732% (95% CI [4.124, 11.856])** of the 194 valid respondents indicated using them, per respondent-level bootstrap (B=10,000, seed 42, percentile method).

### Full CI table (all 10 ranked formats, % of n=194 valid respondents)

| Rank | Format | quoted | % | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BDD_Scenarios | 4 | 2.062 | [0.515, 4.124] |
| 2 | MLCanvas | 15 | 7.732 | [4.124, 11.856] |
| 3 | Vision_Document | 29 | 14.948 | [10.309, 20.103] |
| 3 | Goal_Models | 29 | 14.948 | [10.309, 20.103] |
| 5 | Data_Models | 34 | 17.526 | [12.371, 23.196] |
| 6 | Use_Case_Models | 38 | 19.588 | [14.433, 25.258] |
| 7 | Prototypes | 42 | 21.649 | [15.979, 27.320] |
| 8 | Requirements_Lists | 51 | 26.289 | [20.103, 32.474] |
| 9 | User_Stories | 63 | 32.474 | [25.773, 39.175] |
| 10 | Notebooks | 66 | 34.021 | [27.320, 40.722] |

Excluded from ranking but reported: **Not_Documented** 15.464% [10.825, 20.619] (not a documentation format — absence of documentation), **Others** 7.732% [4.124, 11.856] (free-text catch-all, exact tie with MLCanvas; excluding it makes MLCanvas the unambiguous #2).

### On the question's cited figures
10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501] are **not reproducible from this file**: no column yields either point estimate under either denominator (194 valid → BDD 2.062%, MLCanvas 7.732%; all 276 → 1.449% and 5.435%), and the cited CI half-widths (~0.2 pp) are ~10× narrower than any respondent-level bootstrap at n=194 can produce (SE ≈ 2.2 pp at p≈0.10 → CI of ~±4.3 pp, as seen in our table). Per your instruction, the data's actual figures are reported above, not the cited ones.

### Workflow (for the submission payload)
1. Loaded 276 respondents × 202 columns; Q10 block uses binary "quoted"/"not quoted" flags with string sentinel "-77" (not -99).
2. Excluded 82 sentinel rows (all "Suspended (22)" who never reached Q10; sentinel pattern identical across all 12 Q10 columns, so row- and cell-level exclusion coincide) → n=194 valid respondents, the denominator for all statistics.
3. For each format, statistic = share of valid respondents "quoted"; ranked the 10 concrete formats, excluding "Not_Documented" (not a format) and "Others" (catch-all) from the ranking while reporting both.
4. Respondent-level nonparametric bootstrap, resampling 194 rows with replacement, B=10,000, seed 42; 95% CI = 2.5th/97.5th percentiles.
5. Result: BDD_Scenarios (2.062%) and MLCanvas (7.732%) are the two least-used documentation formats; CI table saved to output/q10_documentation_bootstrap_ci.csv.

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD scenarios and ML Canvas. Among the 194 respondents with valid answers to the documentation question (Q10; 82 suspended respondents marked with the '-77' sentinel were excluded), only 2.062% (95% bootstrap CI [0.515, 4.124]) indicated using BDD scenarios and 7.732% (95% bootstrap CI [4.124, 11.856]) indicated using ML Canvas, the lowest shares among the ten concrete documentation formats. Note: the percentages cited in the question (10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501]) cannot be reproduced from this dataset at n=194 under any reasonable denominator, and their CI widths are about an order of magnitude too narrow for a respondent-level bootstrap at this sample size; the data-grounded values above are reported instead. 'Not_Documented' (15.464%) and 'Others' (7.732%, an exact tie with ML Canvas) were reported but excluded from the ranking, as the former is not a documentation format and the latter is a free-text catch-all.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 respondents, 202 columns); Q10 documentation columns are binary 'quoted'/'not quoted' flags with string sentinel '-77'. 2) Excluded the 82 sentinel rows (all 'Suspended (22)' who never reached Q10; sentinel pattern identical across all 12 Q10 columns, so row- and cell-level exclusion coincide), leaving n=194 valid respondents as the denominator. 3) Computed, per format, the percentage of valid respondents indicating use ('quoted'). 4) Ranked the 10 concrete formats, excluding 'Not_Documented' (absence of documentation, not a format) and 'Others' (free-text catch-all) from the ranking while still reporting their values. 5) Respondent-level nonparametric bootstrap: resampled the 194 rows with replacement, B=10,000 iterations, seed 42; 95% CIs as 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of each format's bootstrap distribution. 6) Identified BDD_Scenarios (2.062%, CI [0.515, 4.124]) and MLCanvas (7.732%, CI [4.124, 11.856]) as the two least-used formats; full CI table saved as an artifact.
